data.title: Keep provenance and rights attached to a 3D derivative
data.summary: One approved source asset, its license text and a derived export. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: The glTF exporter delivers supported geometry, material and animation features.

prerequisites: An authorized Claude Code / Codex / existing Studio environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: One approved source asset, its license text and a derived export.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent asset rights workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: One approved source asset, its license text and a derived export. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Inspect the owning registry for an equivalent source and preserve the original license/provenance record
Record transformations, external textures and model/source identities in the existing receipt
Review the final distribution bundle for attribution, restricted content and embedded private paths

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned keep provenance and rights attached to a 3d derivative candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: The public derivative has no private source paths or credentials
Every external asset has a recorded source and distribution basis
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: An LLM's statement that an asset is safe does not establish ownership or commercial rights.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: A geometry generator's license and a downloaded texture's license are separate obligations.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me keep provenance and rights attached to a 3d derivative in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: One approved source asset, its license text and a derived export. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: The public derivative has no private source paths or credentials; Every external asset has a recorded source and distribution basis. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.

troubleshooting.symptom: An operator, node socket or exporter option is unavailable
troubleshooting.action: Stop and inspect the installed tool/version documentation; adapt the smallest affected step rather than guessing an API name.

troubleshooting.symptom: The candidate fails its stated review condition
troubleshooting.action: Return to the last accepted source/parameter set, reduce to one representative case and record the failed observation. A geometry generator's license and a downloaded texture's license are separate obligations.
